title: San Francisco, CA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to San Francisco, CA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

San Francisco is a city in CA with a population of 808,437. Tech capital with iconic landmarks — and the highest cost of living in America. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 10b growing zone supports Hot — tropical and subtropical crops, year-round growing. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 259 sunny days a year.
